en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 244 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Yaqub from Ali Ibn Muhammad that he said:

“A prohibition came forbidding visitations to the graveyard in Kadhimiyya and the Shrines. A few months later, the minister called Baqitani said to him, “Tell the people of Bani Furat and village of Bars not to visit the graveyard at Kadhmain, because the caliph has ordered that anyone who comes there must be watched and arrested.”
